description: This file defines the BookingAuditTaskConsumer class responsible for processing booking audit tasks, including handling single and bulk audit operations, data migration, feature flag checks, actor resolution, and audit record creation within a booking system.

classes.name: BookingAuditTaskConsumer
classes.description: A class that processes booking audit tasks, manages data migration, feature flag checks, actor resolution, and audit record creation for booking system auditing.

methods.name: processAuditTask
methods.description: Processes a single booking audit task, including migration and action handling.

methods.name: processBulkAuditTask
methods.description: Processes bulk booking audit tasks, including migration and bulk action handling.

methods.name: migrateIfNeeded
methods.description: Validates and migrates data to the latest schema version if needed.

methods.name: updateTaskPayload
methods.description: Updates the task payload in the database with migrated data.

methods.name: bulkMigrateIfNeeded
methods.description: Migrates all bookings in a bulk operation, updating the payload if any migration occurs.

methods.name: updateBulkTaskPayload
methods.description: Updates the bulk task payload in the database with migrated bookings data.

methods.name: shouldProcessAudit
methods.description: Checks if an audit should be processed based on organization feature flags.

methods.name: resolveActorId
methods.description: Resolves an actor to an actor ID, handling different actor identification methods.

methods.name: createAuditRecord
methods.description: Creates a booking audit record in the repository.

methods.name: getRecordType
methods.description: Determines the record type based on the booking action.

methods.name: onBulkBookingActions
methods.description: Creates audit records for bulk booking actions.

methods.name: onBookingAction
methods.description: Creates an audit record for a single booking action.
